title: Traffic Policy parity deepening (QoS class-level editors)
acceptance_criteria: `/network/traffic-policy` supports class CRUD for class-capable QoS policy types (`limiter`, `priority-queue`, `round-robin`, `shaper`).
Save path emits diff-based set/delete operations for `qos policy <type> <name> class <id>` leaves and match/match-group nodes.
Class editor prevents class operations on unsupported policy types to avoid invalid CLI generation.
Validation passes: backend test_app, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: Existing `/vyos/qos` wrapper endpoints remain sufficient for class-level operations.
Initial class editor covers common high-value class fields; additional policy-type-specific leaves remain follow-up.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added QoS class state parsing, class editor UI, class-capable type gating, and class-level diff save generation.
No backend changes required for this slice; existing qos wrapper already supports command subtree.
Validated via backend pytest, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and UI smoke. Recorded and recovered from one startup race during runtime smoke.
Manual review completed in-session; no blocking issues found.
